name: typesafe-web-extract
description: Extract content from live web pages: the browser navigates and copies verbatim, TypeSafe/Jev makes the typed judgments (select, rank, verify). Zero dependencies.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed web extraction with typed Jev judgments
interface.longDescription: Extract content from live web pages: the browser navigates and copies verbatim, TypeSafe/Jev makes the typed judgments (select, rank, verify). Zero dependencies. Requires a TypeSafe API key and browser control; run scripts/preflight.mjs to check.
